subject: Catalyst Labs: Hybrid workshop — availability windows & AM/PM bridges
messages:
From: Sarah White <sarah.white@catalystlabs.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-25T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Workshop planning — week of Dec 6/13 availability?

Hi Diego / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. We want to lock the in-person portion of the Catalyst technical workshop in early December. Key constraints: our execs are on Pacific afternoons (PST) only on Dec 8–10, and the EMEA product team will only be available in the early morning PST window (their afternoons CET).

Can Redwood propose a set of time windows that cover both the US exec AM/PM split and an EMEA-friendly bridge (we expect some virtual sessions)? We prefer Dec 8–10 but can be flexible the week prior. Also need an initial attendee list and a draft agenda to send to security for guest badges.

Attached: draft attendee list (internal) — I can share the vendor/venue contact after you confirm dates.

Best,
Sarah White
Director of Operations | Catalyst Labs
@sarah.white@catalystlabs.com

Attachments: attendee_list_catalyst.xlsx (8KB)

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Sarah White <sarah.white@catalystlabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-25T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Workshop planning — week of Dec 6/13 availability?

Hi Sarah — thanks for the constraints. Proposed approach below (aiming to keep execs in a single 90–120m block and feed in EMEA via a bridge window):

- Option A (Preferred, onsite + virtual bridge):
  - Dec 8, 13:00–15:00 PST (Exec deep-dive, onsite)
  - Dec 9, 08:30–09:30 PST (EMEA bridge — recorded Q&A)
- Option B (Split days):
  - Dec 8, 10:00–12:00 PST (Exec + product alignment)
  - Dec 10, 07:30–09:00 PST (EMEA co-watch + breakout rooms)

Practical asks from our side: final attendee list by Nov 30, AV requirements by Dec 1, and travel arrival no later than Dec 7 for the onsite team. We'll keep a virtual fallback (same calendar invites with Google Meet and a streaming link).

I attached a working agenda (Catalyst_Agenda_v2.pdf) and a simple venue floor map for Level 4 — note the AV rack sits in Room B. Marissa, can you confirm headcount for the breakout rooms and whether we need 2x 65" screens or 1 projector?

Thanks — I can set up a shared timeline doc and a mutual action plan (MAP) once you confirm Option A or B.

Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Sarah / team — quick ops notes from my side:
- AV: we recommend 2x 65" + wireless lapel for execs and a room mics matrix for audience Q&A. If the venue only has a projector, we need an HDMI run + backup Mac mini.
- Catering: light breakfast + boxed lunch for Dec 8 and 9. Please confirm dietary restrictions with the attendee list.
- Local host: Aaron Patel (aaron@catalystlabs.com) will be on-site and the venue main contact is venue-logistics@grandharbor.com.
- Badges: security needs full legal names + company + email by Nov 30 to process visitor badges.

I'll draft the MAP in the shared doc and link it into the calendar invites. Camila — can you reserve two breakout rooms adjacent to Room B on Level 4 and confirm capacity?

Thanks,
